$comment: Hand-entered decennial census counts for the City of Milwaukee (place 55-53000), before the machine-readable estimate files begin in 2000. 1990 appears as the April-1990 base in the Census 1990s city estimates table su-99-01 as 628,300 (a revised base); the published 1990 count is 628,088. These four numbers are the only hand-typed figures in the harness. 2000-2024 come from popest files and are not repeated here.
source: US Census Bureau, decennial census counts (1960-1990)
